wargear.name: Mirror-cloak
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A shimmering mantle that throws back a dozen false outlines of its wearer. The bearer gains Shrouded (6+), or one step better if they already have it.

wargear.name: Reagent injector
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A wrist-mounted cocktail of stimms and counter-toxins, tuned for agents who expect to be poisoned in return. The bearer gains Feel No Pain (6+).

wargear.name: Sleeper-cell beacon
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tiny pulse-caster that lets scattered cells act on a single plan without a word on the vox. Every model in the unit gains +1 Cool and +1 Intelligence.

option.text: The Headhunter Prime may exchange their power dagger for
Any Headhunter may exchange their bolt pistol for a Viper dart pistol
Any Recon Legionary may exchange their Astartes shotgun for a Coil-spined needle carbine
Any Scout may exchange their bolter for a Coil-spined needle carbine
The Sergeant may wear a Mirror-cloak
The unit may carry a Sleeper-cell beacon

modifiers.text: Trained to kill the head, not the body: +1 BS, -1 CL.
Every legionary a cell leader: +1 IN, -1 LD.
Shadow-killers with no home to return to: +1 BS, -1 CL.
Hardened by purge after purge: +1 LD, -1 M.

rites.name: A Hundred Cells, One Hand
rites.flavor: No cell knows the plan. Every cell knows its part.
benefits: Headhunter Kill Teams, Seeker Squads and Reconnaissance Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Those units gain Cell Network: a failed Cool Check may be re-rolled while another friendly unit with Cell Network is within 12".
limitations: At least two Headhunter Kill Teams are required.
No Armour, Heavy Transport or Lord of War units.

require.note: Field at least two Headhunter Kill Teams.

modifiers.text: A Hundred Cells, One Hand: Cell Network, Line (1).

rites.name: The Sleeper Awakens
rites.flavor: They were standing beside you before the war began.
benefits: Tactical, Veteran Tactical and Inductii Squads gain Infiltrate (9).
Those units gain Sleeper Strike: in the controlling player's first turn they may re-roll failed Charge rolls.
limitations: No Transport, Heavy Transport or Fast Attack units.
Units with Sleeper Strike must be deployed on the table with Infiltrate; they may not start in Reserve.

modifiers.text: The Sleeper Awakens: Sleeper Strike, Infiltrate (9).

rites.name: The Hydra's Gambit
rites.flavor: Alpharius is present, and three other Alpharii are also present.
benefits: Exodus, Headhunter Kill Teams and Mor Deythan Squads gain Hatred (Command) and Many Heads: Outflank, and after both sides have deployed the Alpha Legion player may swap the positions of two units with Many Heads.
limitations: Alpharius must be in the army.
At most one Tactical Squad and no Veteran Tactical Squads.

modifiers.text: The Hydra's Gambit: Many Heads, Hatred (Command), Outflank.

rites.name: Dreadwing Purge-Host
rites.flavor: When the whispers fail, the Dreadwing is sent to finish the argument.
benefits: Dreadwing Interemptor and Lernaean Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1) and Purge Resolve: they automatically pass Cool Checks while within 6" of another friendly unit with Purge Resolve.
Interemptors gain Rending (6+) in close combat and shooting.
limitations: At least two Dreadwing Interemptor Squads are required.
No Recon or Fast Attack units.

require.note: Field at least two Interemptor Squads.

rules.name: Cell Network
rules.text: Legacy house rule (A Hundred Cells, One Hand). A unit with this rule may re-roll a failed Cool Check while at least one other friendly unit with Cell Network is within 12".

rules.name: Sleeper Strike
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Sleeper Awakens). In its controlling player's first turn, a unit with this rule may re-roll failed Charge rolls. The unit must be deployed on the table using Infiltrate, and may not start in Reserve.

rules.name: Many Heads
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Hydra's Gambit). A unit with this rule gains Outflank. After both armies have deployed, the Alpha Legion player may swap the positions of two units with this rule (both units must be on the table, in the same deployment zone).

rules.name: Purge Resolve
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Dreadwing Purge-Host). A unit with this rule automatically passes Cool Checks while it is within 6" of at least one other friendly unit with this rule.
